conventions.boxes: Square brackets in a node label delimit the printed residue kernel
conventions.c_or_cstar: complete graph or its dual; literal star retained
conventions.P_or_Pstar: Petersen graph or its dual; literal star retained
conventions.triples: Ordered by proximity to the two recorded endpoints
conventions.Cor_omitted: Source states Cor is printed only if different from Aut; filled value is a convention inference, not a literal inscription
